title: Generalized Complexity Distances and Non-Invertible Symmetries
summary: Non-invertible symmetries of a quantum field theory (QFT) are a natural generalization of unitary symmetries, but in which the product of operators does not satisfy a group multiplication law. We show that such symmetry operations on states define a collection of quantum gates for a parallel quantum computation scheme that includes post-selection / projection as a gate. Structures such as gate complexity and more geometric complexity measures generalize to this setting.
